status: read-only candidate; no Draft, registry entity, Primary Node, or CFEL extension has been admitted or implemented

scope.goal: Replace only the two admission-dependent prose constraints without inferring admissions from observed instance data.

candidate_rule.name: Resolve admitted literal values
exact_rule_text: ADMITTED_VALUES(p) returns the complete explicit set of admitted literal values for logical Property p in the selected effective MODEL and current bearer context. It resolves local MODEL admissions before inherited admissions and applies the selected effective local override where one exists.

The query is defined for a logical Property even when that Property has no authored occurrence and has no value. It never derives admissions from observed Property values, Carrier content, filenames, paths, or actual instances.

For Atom.Form, the bearer context includes that Atom's resolved Role. For Relation Definition Content.notation_for_subject, it includes the Relation target resolved from that same Definition's Active Subject. A missing or ambiguous Role, Active Subject, Relation target, effective MODEL, or admission binding is an error, not an empty set.

The Evaluation Context explicitly supplies ModelCase, Source, and AuthoritativeEpoch bindings and the effective-MODEL/admission index. They are evaluation bindings, not authored Artifact fields or new graph entities. A known indexed Property with no admissions returns the known empty set; an unknown, incomplete, or ambiguous index errors and cannot pass.

ADMITTED_VALUES(p){=1+} tests the count of returned admitted values. Scalar `v in S` and `v not in S` test literal membership where S is ADMITTED_VALUES(p) or an explicit scalar value collection `(e1, ...)`. This does not alter existing instance-set membership, identity comparison, or selector semantics.
The function reads admissions only. It does not author a Property, assign a value, create a Node, promote a value, or make an observed literal admitted.

semantic_boundaries.literal_only: Results are admitted literals, not Nodes or implicit registry entities.
semantic_boundaries.override: A local effective-MODEL override replaces the inherited admission binding for the same logical Property; otherwise inherited admissions remain effective.
semantic_boundaries.error_vs_empty: Known empty means an authoritative resolved binding explicitly has zero values. Unknown or unresolved means error.

claim_rewrites.subject: Atom.Form
replaces: Form is an admitted atomic unit under the Atom's Role.
Do not invent a placeholder Form or copy a Role name as a Form.
claim_rewrites.preservation: The first membership rejects placeholders and every unregistered Form. The second is the supplied same-bearer Role-name anti-copy test. Shape, required value, and no-children constraints are unchanged.
claim_rewrites.counterexample_before: Role Requirement with Form Placeholder satisfies the existing string shape; Role Requirement with Form Requirement also satisfies it.
claim_rewrites.counterexample_after: Placeholder fails unless explicitly admitted for the resolved Requirement-role context; Requirement fails the explicit Atom.Role anti-copy test.

claim_rewrites.subject: Atom/(.Role := Requirement)/(.Form := Relation Definition).Content.notation_for_subject
replaces: When a short subject notation is admitted for the Relation, this Property is required.
claim_rewrites.preservation: The guard requires the optional Property only when the resolved Relation has one or more admitted short notations. It deliberately does not assert that an authored notation value is a member of that set, because that would add a norm absent from the source clause.
claim_rewrites.counterexample_before: A Relation with one admitted short notation may omit notation_for_subject while meeting the existing optional shape.
claim_rewrites.counterexample_after: That omission fails; a known empty admission set leaves the Property optional as before.

examples.name: Relation-notation-required-only-on-nonempty-set
examples.context: The same Relation Definition's Active Subject resolves its Relation target. Its admission set for notation_for_subject is nonempty.
examples.result: fail; with a known empty set, absence passes
